extraction.Name: Rebecca Rooks Livermont
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (reservation not explicitly named)
extraction.Cancelled: an application for cancellation is now pending in the Indian Office
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee, but that she took on the advise of the Farmer and the Supt, decidedly under protest
extraction.Recorded patent: her husband had the patent recorded about six months ago
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: has not sold or mortgaged her land
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: if her patent is cancelled that she will have her land, but that if it is not cancelled, she can not pay the taxes, and will lose it
extraction.NOTES: Has five children, all in fair health, depending on her; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since the patent was issued; document sworn November 13, 1928; mentally competent, in fair health
